nodes.name: PROJECT.md
nodes.summary: Pact Charter (protocol v1) defining roles (orchestrator/worker/reviewer/human), the two immutable rules (worker cannot self-accept; feature cannot merge until all tasks accepted), the registered seats (claude, opencode-worker, gemini-worker), and the command surface via `pactify help`.

nodes.name: STATE.yml
nodes.summary: Project state projection listing the four registered agents (claude, opencode-worker, gemini-worker, kimi-worker) and a long history of shipped features (planner, finishstep, sessions, recipe, audit, manifest-cd, sp1-backend, sp-backend, projwiz, cloud-m0, ds-abstraction, ts-projection, driver-modernization, review-runtime, etc.) with their tasks, owners, reviewers, specs, and accepted-status evidence.

nodes.name: plan-liveview.json
nodes.summary: Feature plan for `liveview` on branch `feat-liveview`, defining three serial tasks (step1 Go orchestrate tests, step2 Go serve tests, step3 web vitest) each with owner, reviewer, spec path, verify command, and dependency chain step1→step2→step3.
